attempts.sql: SELECT split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS sub, 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM code.file_profile WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND array_length(string_split(file_id, '/')) > 3 GROUP BY sub HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC

request:
Within auto_ontology/server/, which immediate subfolders contain more than 1,000 lines of Python in total? Count every .py file anywhere inside the subfolder, including its test files and __init__.py; files directly in auto_ontology/server/ itself belong to no subfolder. Return the subfolder's repository-relative path (e.g. auto_ontology/server/chat) and its total line count.

Requested output columns: folder_path (string), total_lines (integer).
explanation: Filters files under auto_ontology/server/, extracts the immediate subfolder (third path component) only for files nested deeper than the server directory itself, sums line counts per subfolder, and keeps those exceeding 1,000 lines. Files directly in auto_ontology/server/ are excluded because they have no fourth path component.
sql: SELECT split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS sub, 'auto_ontology/server/' || split_part(file_id, '/', 3) AS folder_path, SUM(line_count) AS total_lines FROM code.file_profile WHERE file_id LIKE 'auto_ontology/server/%' AND array_length(string_split(file_id, '/')) > 3 GROUP BY sub HAVING SUM(line_count) > 1000 ORDER BY total_lines DESC
